name: LSM6DS3 accelerometer & gyroscope
description: STMicroelectronics 6-axis IMU: 3-axis accelerometer (±2/4/8/16 g) and 3-axis gyroscope (±125–2000 dps) plus a die temperature sensor, read over I2C (or SPI). Runs on 1.71–3.6 V and its pins are not 5 V tolerant. Sold as: SparkFun 6 Degrees of Freedom Breakout - LSM6DS3 (SEN-13339), main 6-pin header GND, 3.3V, SDA, SCL, SDO/SA0, CS (second 5-pin header INT2, INT1, OCS, SCX, SDX not modelled), I2C address 0x6B (0x6A with the ADDR jumper changed), no regulator, 4.7 kΩ I2C pull-ups fitted.
eli5: Feels which way it is tilted and how fast it is spinning, so your project knows how it is moving.

pins.name: 3.3V
pins.description: Supply VDD, 1.8–3.6 V (no regulator on the board: never 5 V)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (SPI MOSI); 4.7 kΩ pull-up on the board (PU_EN jumper)

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C / SPI clock; 4.7 kΩ pull-up on the board

pins.name: SDO/SA0
pins.description: I2C address bit (set by the ADDR jumper: 0x6B default) / SPI MISO; leave unconnected for I2C

pins.name: CS
pins.description: Mode select: leave unconnected (10 kΩ pull-up = I2C mode); SPI chip select

buildNotes: Power from 3.3 V only: the breakout has no regulator and the LSM6DS3 is rated 3.6 V max (4.8 V absolute).
Leave CS unconnected (pulled up on the board) so the chip stays in I2C mode, and leave SDO/SA0 unconnected: the ADDR jumper sets address 0x6B.

Check WHO_AM_I (register 0x0F) reads 0x69 first; then write CTRL3_C = 0x44 (BDU + auto-increment), CTRL1_XL = 0x40 (104 Hz, ±2 g) and CTRL2_G = 0x40 (104 Hz, ±245 dps). Both sensors are powered down until you do.
Outputs are 16-bit two's complement, low byte first: accel 0x28–0x2D (0.061 mg/LSB at ±2 g), gyro 0x22–0x27 (8.75 mdps/LSB at ±245 dps), temperature 0x20–0x21 (25 °C + raw/16).
Mount the board firmly: the axes printed on the board are the sensor's X, Y, Z.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from lsm6ds3 import LSM6DS3

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
imu = LSM6DS3(i2c)  # 0x6B: SparkFun ADDR jumper default
while True:
    ax, ay, az = imu.acceleration()
    gx, gy, gz = imu.gyro()
    t = imu.temperature()
    print('A=%.2f,%.2f,%.2fg G=%.1f,%.1f,%.1fdps T=%.1fC' % (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz, t))
    time.sleep(1)

test.title: Reports the tilt, rotation and temperature set on the sliders
